description: Every sale of your strategies, newest first: price paid, platform fee, what you received, the subscription's status and expiry, and a buyer_ref (a stable anonymous id — never the buyer's identity). Tips from users appear here too (type 'tip', with the tipper's short message if any). Totals across all sales and tips are included.

since.description: ISO timestamp — only sales after this moment
